name: @guardbee/mcp-threat-rules
description: GuardBee MCP bridge to Agent Threat Rules (ATR) — evaluate agent/MCP events against the open detection standard for prompt injection, tool poisoning, and MCP attacks
long_description: Wraps the MIT-licensed agent-threat-rules (ATR) engine as a GuardBee MCP server. ATR is a Sigma-like runtime detection layer for AI agent events. Matches include GuardBee follow-up hints that point to static auditors (toxic-flow, tool-poisoning, OAuth, prompt-injection, etc.). Complements GuardBee's source/catalog scanners with industry-standard runtime rules used across Microsoft, Cisco, and other adopters.
